cards.name: Stance Shift
cards.frequency: Uses the same once-per-round stance switch
cards.effect: Stance Shift. Tags: base, passive-upgrade, stance. Your automatic core stance change may be used as a Reaction when you are targeted by an attack, forced to make a saving throw, or immediately before an ally within 15 feet receives healing. The new stance applies before the triggering roll or healing resolves. This consumes your one stance switch for that round and never grants a second switch.

source.originalText: Stance Shift: Switch stance freely once per round.

cards.name: Discipline Initiate
cards.effect: Discipline Initiate. Tags: base, discipline. Choose Offense, Tank or Support. Offense technique: once per turn in Tiger after an unarmed hit, spend 1 Ki to deal +S damage and push the target 5 feet if it is no more than one size larger. Tank: unlock the Tortoise Discipline Arch cards under the common gate. Support technique: once per turn in Crane after an unarmed hit, spend 1 Ki to grant one ally within 15 feet S+M temporary HP. The chosen discipline cannot be changed without a future retraining rule.

source.originalText: Discipline Initiate: Choose a discipline (offense, tank, support) and gain 1 technique based on it.

cards.name: Flurry of Blows
cards.rangeAndTarget: One or two creatures within your unarmed reach
cards.effect: Flurry of Blows. Tags: base, active, attack, ki. Make exactly two separate unarmed strikes. The first successful Flurry strike on your turn grants 1 Ki. If both strikes hit different creatures, the second may grant 1 additional Ki, subject to the normal own-turn gain ceiling. Tiger critical generation and Flowing Form may occur, but the total Ki gained on your turn still cannot exceed 2.

source.originalText: Flurry of Blows: Deliver a rapid sequence of unarmed strikes, with each hit having a chance to generate Ki Chain.

cards.name: Deflect Missile
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; triggering ranged weapon or projectile attack
cards.effect: Deflect Missile. Tags: base, active, defense. Trigger when a ranged weapon or physical projectile attack hits you. Reduce its damage by 1d10 + Dexterity modifier + Monk level, minimum 0. If damage becomes 0 and the projectile can be held, you catch it. You may immediately spend 1 Ki to throw that projectile at one creature within 30 feet as part of the same Reaction, making a normal ranged attack with it.

source.originalText: Deflect Missile: React to a ranged attack by reducing its damage and potentially catching the projectile.

cards.name: Step of the Wind
cards.effect: Step of the Wind. Tags: base, active, mobility, weave. Until the end of the turn, your walking Speed increases by 15 feet, your jump distance doubles, and your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. This is a minor Weave technique; you may spend 1 additional Ki under the common Weave interface if needed to prevent its 1 Dissonance.

source.originalText: Step of the Wind: Harness your ki to dramatically increase your movement speed and jumping distance for one turn.

cards.name: Patient Defense
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Patient Defense. Tags: base, active, defense. Gain +2 AC until the start of your next regular turn. The first time before then that an attack misses you, gain 1 Ki subject to the off-turn gain ceiling. Multiple misses do not generate additional Ki from Patient Defense during that interval.

source.originalText: Patient Defense: Enter a defensive state that increases your dodge chance and generates Ki Chain when successfully avoiding attacks.

cards.name: Stunning Strike
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.frequency: Once per target per encounter for Stunned
cards.effect: Stunning Strike. Tags: base, active, attack, control. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit the target makes a Constitution save. On failure it is Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the common Monk Stun Guard. On success it suffers only the strike's normal damage. A creature already marked by your Stun Guard instead loses its Reaction on a failed save.

source.originalText: Stunning Strike: Channel ki into a precise strike that can temporarily paralyze an opponent if they fail to resist.

cards.name: Combo Step
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature hit by three different named Monk attack techniques in the same round
cards.frequency: Once per target per encounter for Stunned
cards.effect: Combo Step. Tags: arch, passive, combo, control. When you hit the same creature during one round with three different named Monk attack techniques, it makes a Constitution save after the third hit. On failure it is Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the Stun Guard. Ordinary repeated unarmed strikes with no distinct technique names do not satisfy the three-technique requirement.

source.originalText: Combo Step: Use three different unarmed attacks in one round to stun the target.

cards.name: Ki Reversal
cards.cost: 1 Ki; requires at least 4 Ki before spending
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature that hits you with a melee attack
cards.effect: Ki Reversal. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, defense, counter. When a melee attack hits you while you have at least 4 Ki, spend 1 Ki to reduce the triggering damage by 1d8+M, minimum 0, then make one unarmed strike against the attacker if it is within reach. The counter is part of the Reaction and cannot generate an additional Action.

source.originalText: Ki Reversal: At 4+ Ki Chain, auto-counter the next melee hit.

cards.name: Perfect Balance
cards.effect: Perfect Balance. Tags: arch, passive, stance. If you have not moved before making your first unarmed attack on your turn, that attack scores a critical hit on natural 19 or 20; this does not widen Tiger beyond 19-20. If instead you move at least 10 feet during your turn, gain +1 AC until the start of your next regular turn. The AC benefit does not stack with itself.

source.originalText: Perfect Balance: Standing still: +15% crit. Moving: +15% dodge.

cards.name: Breath of Focus
cards.frequency: Once per turn in a real encounter
cards.effect: Breath of Focus. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, ki. Use your Action and make no attack as part of this feature. Gain 1 Ki, subject to the own-turn gain ceiling. This represents deliberately surrendering offense to center yourself and cannot generate Ki outside a real encounter, during a rest, or by repeatedly entering initiative without opposition.

source.originalText: Breath of Focus: Skip an attack to gain +1 Ki Chain.

cards.name: Rhythmic Flow
cards.frequency: Every third regular turn while at 5 Ki
cards.effect: Rhythmic Flow. Tags: arch, passive, critical. Count your regular Monk turns during a real encounter. On every third such turn, if you begin an unarmed strike while at 5 Ki, that strike automatically becomes a critical hit if it hits. The effect applies to the first qualifying strike only, then the three-turn count restarts. Encounter end resets the count.

source.originalText: Rhythmic Flow: Every 3rd round, next strike auto-crits at max Ki.

cards.name: Martial Apex (Capstone)
cards.rangeAndTarget: One Monk Action technique you are beginning to use
cards.effect: Martial Apex. Tags: arch, capstone, action. When at exactly 5 Ki, spend all 5 as you begin a Monk technique that normally requires an Action. That technique does not consume your normal Action but counts as the one additional full Action allowed to you that round. Add one additional copy of its base rolled damage dice to one damage roll. It cannot be used on healing-only techniques or a Hero Final. Spending all 5 Ki replaces only that technique's printed Ki cost; any RP, rest-use, target and recharge requirements are still paid/met. The bonus dice apply to one target only, cannot copy critical bonus dice, and cannot generate further attacks or resources.

source.originalText: Martial Apex (Capstone): At 5 Ki, your next ability costs no action and deals +100% damage (1/encounter).

cards.name: Stone Shell Discipline
cards.duration: While unarmored and Tortoise is active
cards.effect: Stone Shell Discipline. Tags: arch, tortoise, discipline, defense. While in Tortoise Stance and at 3 or more Ki, gain +1 AC and you cannot be forcibly moved or knocked Prone by a creature no more than one size larger than you. Dropping below 3 Ki immediately suspends these benefits until you return to 3 or more.

source.originalText: Stone Shell Discipline: +15% DR and Ki Chain protection at 3+ Ki. Immune to forced movement.

cards.name: Redirecting Palm
cards.rangeAndTarget: Triggering melee attacker and one other enemy within 5 feet of you
cards.effect: Redirecting Palm. Tags: arch, tortoise, discipline, counter. When a melee attack damages you, spend 1 Ki. Reduce the actual damage you take by half, rounded down. Choose one enemy other than you within 5 feet; it takes force damage equal to the amount prevented, maximum Monk level. If no second enemy is present, you still receive the reduction but redirect no damage.

source.originalText: Redirecting Palm: Spend 1 Ki to redirect 50% of incoming melee damage to a nearby enemy.

cards.name: Iron Shell Pulse
cards.rangeAndTarget: You and up to three allies within 15 feet
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Iron Shell Pulse. Tags: arch, tortoise, discipline, protection, weave. Each target reduces the first damage it takes before the duration ends by PB. After that reduction occurs, the attacker takes S force damage if within 30 feet, at most once per protected creature. This is a minor Weave technique; the optional common extra Ki payment may prevent its 1 Dissonance.

source.originalText: Iron Shell Pulse: Spend 3 Ki: grant nearby allies 10% DR and retaliation aura.

cards.name: Echoing Guard
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature whose attack misses you or whose attack you reduce to 0 damage
cards.duration: Until end of that creature's next turn
cards.frequency: At most once per attacker per round
cards.effect: Echoing Guard. Tags: arch, tortoise, discipline, defense. When an attack misses you, or one of your defensive techniques reduces the triggering attack to 0 damage, the attacker becomes Staggered: -1 to attack rolls and -5 feet Speed until the end of its next turn. Reapplication refreshes but does not stack.

source.originalText: Echoing Guard: Blocking/dodging applies Stagger (-10% damage, -1 move).

cards.name: Final Form – Bastion of Breath
cards.cost: Spend all 5 Ki; requires Tank Discipline and at least three other Tortoise cards
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn; shockwave then resolves
cards.frequency: 1/long rest; automatic gated Tortoise Final Form
cards.effect: Final Form — Bastion of Breath. Tags: arch, tortoise, final-form, defense, weave. Spend all 5 Ki. Until the start of your next regular turn you are immune to damage, though conditions that do not require damage may still affect you. Each enemy that hits you during this period makes a Constitution save; failure would Stun it, subject to the Stun Guard. At the start of your next turn, creatures of your choice within 15 feet make Strength saves, taking 2 S d8 force damage and being pushed 10 feet on failure, half damage and no push on success. This is the Arch-discipline exception and does not replace your later Hero path.

source.originalText: Final Form – Bastion of Breath: Become immune for 1 round. Enemies who strike are stunned. On next round, release a force shockwave.

cards.name: Whirlwind Stance
cards.effect: Whirlwind Stance. Tags: arch, active, attack. Despite its historical name, this is a technique rather than a fourth core Stance and does not replace Tiger, Tortoise or Crane. Make one unarmed strike against each of up to three different creatures within reach. Roll separately. Ki generation from these hits remains subject to the normal own-turn ceiling.

source.originalText: Whirlwind Stance: Enter a flowing stance that allows you to strike multiple adjacent enemies with each attack.

cards.name: Focused Ki Burst
cards.effect: Focused Ki Burst. Tags: arch, active, weave, damage. Creatures of your choice in the burst make Dexterity saves, taking S d8 force damage on failure or half on success. This is a minor Weave technique. After validating its printed costs, you may spend 1 additional Ki to prevent the 1 Dissonance it would otherwise create under the protected interface.

source.originalText: Focused Ki Burst: Channel your ki into a powerful energy discharge that damages enemies in a small area.

cards.name: Diamond Soul
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Diamond Soul. Tags: arch, active, weave, defense. Until the start of your next regular turn, gain +2 on saving throws and reduce each instance of damage you take by PB, minimum 0. This is a minor Weave technique; you may spend 1 additional Ki through the common interface to prevent its 1 Dissonance.

source.originalText: Diamond Soul: Temporarily harden your body against physical and magical attacks, gaining resistance to damage.

cards.name: Pressure Point Strike
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: Pressure Point Strike. Tags: arch, active, attack, control. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit the target makes a Constitution save. On failure choose Arm or Leg: Arm gives -1 on attack rolls; Leg reduces Speed by 10 feet, minimum 0. This represents temporary disruption only and causes no persistent limb injury.

source.originalText: Pressure Point Strike: Target a specific vulnerability in your opponent, potentially disabling a limb or ability temporarily.

cards.name: Meditative Healing
cards.effect: Meditative Healing. Tags: arch, active, healing, weave. Regain S d8 + M HP, then regain 1 Ki after resolution, never above 5. The restored Ki does not count as a normal generator but cannot be used if this feature was activated outside a real encounter merely to farm Ki. It removes no Wounds. As a minor Weave technique, you may spend 1 additional Ki before resolution to prevent its 1 Dissonance.

source.originalText: Meditative Healing: Enter a brief meditative state that rapidly restores your health and ki.

cards.name: Tranquil Lotus Step
cards.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally within your walking Speed
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Tranquil Lotus Step. Tags: hero, enlightened, support, cleanse. Move up to your Speed toward a willing ally without provoking opportunity attacks. If you finish within 5 feet, choose Charmed, Frightened or Poisoned currently affecting that ally; end it on the ally and apply that same condition to yourself until the end of your next regular turn if you are not immune. The ally gains +S HP the next time it receives healing before then.

source.originalText: Tranquil Lotus Step: Move to ally, absorb their debuff, and grant +15% healing received (2 Ki).

cards.name: Serenity Breaker Palm
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy within unarmed reach; allies within 10 feet
cards.effect: Serenity Breaker Palm. Tags: hero, enlightened, attack, cleanse. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit, choose up to M living allies within 10 feet of you; each may end either Charmed, Frightened or Poisoned. The cleansing occurs only if the strike hits. It removes no Wounds, curses or disease and generates no Ki beyond ordinary attack generators.

source.originalText: Serenity Breaker Palm: Strike enemy; cleanse allies in 2 tiles (3 Ki).

cards.name: Balance Beyond Flesh
cards.rangeAndTarget: Allies within 15 feet while you are in Crane Stance
cards.effect: Balance Beyond Flesh. Tags: hero, enlightened, support, healing. During a real encounter, when an ally within 15 feet spends at least 1 point from a finite class resource such as Ki, RP or Conviction, you may pay 1 RP for that ally to regain S HP, at most once per round. It cannot trigger from free abilities, staged spending outside combat or resources immediately refunded by the same event.

source.originalText: Balance Beyond Flesh: Allies in Crane stance range heal 5% each time they spend a resource.

cards.name: Breath of the Thousand Petals
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to six allies within 20 feet
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Final — Breath of the Thousand Petals. Tags: hero, enlightened, final, resurrection, weave. Living or Downed allies in range regain 3 S d8+M HP. Up to two allied creatures that died since the end of your previous regular turn return to life at 1 HP if their bodies can sustain life. Until the start of your next turn, affected living allies cannot be reduced below 1 HP by damage, though instant-death effects still function. It removes no Wounds and cannot revive the same creature twice.

source.originalText: Final – Breath of the Thousand Petals: AoE revive and death immunity (1 round).

cards.name: Healing Touch
cards.effect: Healing Touch. Tags: hero, enlightened, healing, weave. The target regains S d8+M HP and may immediately repeat one saving throw against Poisoned or disease if that effect normally permits repeated saves. This does not resurrect, remove Wounds or automatically cure disease. It is a minor Weave technique; the common extra-Ki payment may prevent its 1 Dissonance.

source.originalText: Healing Touch: Channel positive ki energy through your hands to heal injuries and cure minor ailments.

cards.name: Purifying Palm
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy within unarmed reach; allies within 10 feet
cards.effect: Purifying Palm. Tags: hero, enlightened, attack, cleanse. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit choose up to two allies within 10 feet. Each may end Frightened or Poisoned. If you spend one additional Ki after the hit, one chosen ally may instead end Charmed. It removes no curse, disease or Wound.

source.originalText: Purifying Palm: Strike an enemy while simultaneously cleansing negative effects from nearby allies.

cards.name: Circle of Harmony
cards.cost: 2 Ki + 3 RP to start; 1 RP maintenance
cards.effect: Circle of Harmony. Tags: hero, enlightened, healing, zone, weave, sustained. On start and each paid Bonus Action maintenance pulse, up to three living allies in the zone regain S d6+M HP. Maximum 3 pulses. A creature receives this named effect at most once per round. It removes no Wounds and cannot restore the dead.

source.originalText: Circle of Harmony: Create a zone of balanced energy that gradually restores health to allies within it.

cards.name: Shared Breath
cards.effect: Shared Breath. Tags: hero, enlightened, link, weave. Link yourself to one willing ally. Once per round when either linked creature takes damage, the other may use its Reaction to take up to S+M of that damage instead; transferred damage cannot be reduced or redirected again. HP healing received by either creature also grants the other S HP once per round. The link ends if you separate by more than 30 feet.

source.originalText: Shared Breath: Temporarily link your life force with an ally, sharing damage and healing effects.

cards.name: Transcendent Meditation
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to three allies within 15 feet
cards.effect: Transcendent Meditation. Tags: hero, enlightened, healing, weave, sustained. On start and at the start of each of your next two regular turns while concentration holds, each target regains S d6 HP. You regain 1 Ki on the second pulse only, never above 5. Targets must remain within 15 feet. This finite healing cannot be restarted until the short-rest use refreshes.

source.originalText: Transcendent Meditation: Enter a deep meditative state that dramatically accelerates healing for yourself and nearby allies.

cards.name: Ribcrusher Strike
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature hit by your unarmed strike
cards.duration: Until target completes a short or long rest
cards.effect: Ribcrusher Strike. Tags: hero, iron-fist, attack, max-hp. After an unarmed strike hits, spend 2 Ki. The target makes a Constitution save. On failure reduce its maximum HP by S+M, minimum maximum HP 1. This reduction follows the common non-stacking maximum-HP rule and is restored after a completed short or long rest without restoring current HP.

source.originalText: Ribcrusher Strike: Heavy strike, reduces enemy max HP by 10% (2 Ki).

cards.name: Centerline Blitz
cards.rangeAndTarget: 20-foot line ending in an unoccupied space you can occupy
cards.effect: Centerline Blitz. Tags: hero, iron-fist, mobility, attack, control. Move along the line without provoking opportunity attacks and make one unarmed strike against each of up to three different creatures whose spaces you pass within reach of. If you had exactly 5 Ki before paying the cost, the final creature hit makes a Constitution save; failure would Stun it until the end of its next turn, subject to the Stun Guard.

source.originalText: Centerline Blitz: Dash in a line, striking all targets. Final one is stunned at max Ki (3 Ki).

cards.name: Steel Reflection Form
cards.effect: Steel Reflection Form. Tags: hero, iron-fist, defense. For 3 rounds, once per round when a creature within 5 feet deals melee damage to you, that creature takes force damage equal to S+M after the triggering damage resolves. Reflected damage cannot trigger another reflection, counterattack, resource gain or proc chain.

source.originalText: Steel Reflection Form: Reflect 15% melee damage for 3 turns.

cards.name: Limit Break Spiral
cards.effect: Final — Limit Break Spiral. Tags: hero, iron-fist, final, attack. This pilot does not grant two Bonus Actions. Instead, after activation your unarmed strikes score critical hits on natural 19 or 20 for the rest of the turn, and once this turn when you use an Action Monk attack technique you may make one additional unarmed strike as part of that same technique. This grants no extra Bonus Action and cannot exceed the universal additional-full-Action cap.

source.originalText: Final – Limit Break Spiral: 2 bonus actions; all strikes crit this turn (1/day).

cards.name: Iron Palm
cards.effect: Iron Palm. Tags: hero, iron-fist, attack. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit add S d6 force damage. For this attack only, resistance to the strike's normal bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage is ignored; immunity remains immunity. The force rider uses normal resistance and immunity.

source.originalText: Iron Palm: Channel ki into your strike to ignore a portion of the target's armor and resistance.

cards.name: Flowing Combo
cards.effect: Flowing Combo. Tags: hero, iron-fist, attack. Make exactly three separate unarmed strikes against one creature. The first deals normal damage, the second successful hit adds S damage, and the third successful hit adds 2 S damage. These are flat bonuses, not extra attacks. Ki generation from the strikes remains capped by the normal own-turn ceiling.

source.originalText: Flowing Combo: Execute a series of perfectly coordinated strikes that build upon each other, with increasing damage per hit.

cards.name: Focused Breathing
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Focused Breathing. Tags: hero, iron-fist, focus. Until the end of your next regular turn, your unarmed strikes score critical hits on natural 19 or 20. If another feature already provides 19-20, the ranges do not widen further. You also gain advantage on the next Constitution save you make before the effect ends.

source.originalText: Focused Breathing: Enter a state of perfect concentration, significantly increasing your critical hit chance for a short duration.

cards.name: Bone-Breaking Strike
cards.duration: Until target completes a short or long rest
cards.effect: Bone-Breaking Strike. Tags: hero, iron-fist, attack, max-hp. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit, the target makes a Constitution save. On failure reduce its maximum HP by 2 S+M under the common non-stacking maximum-HP rule. This creates no persistent broken-limb injury; the maximum returns after a completed short or long rest without restoring current HP.

source.originalText: Bone-Breaking Strike: Deliver a powerful blow that can temporarily reduce the target's maximum health.

cards.name: One Hundred Fists
cards.rangeAndTarget: One or more creatures within unarmed reach
cards.effect: One Hundred Fists. Tags: hero, iron-fist, attack. Make exactly four separate unarmed strikes, distributing them among creatures within reach as desired. Each uses normal attack and damage rules. No strike grants another attack or Action. Ki generators may trigger, but because the activation spent all 5 Ki, total Ki gained during the turn remains subject to the usual own-turn ceiling.

source.originalText: One Hundred Fists: Ultimate technique that allows you to strike with incredible speed, delivering numerous attacks in a single moment.

cards.name: Veinlock Nerve Jab
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature hit by your unarmed strike
cards.effect: Veinlock Nerve Jab. Tags: hero, shadow, attack, control. After an unarmed strike hits, spend 2 Ki. The target makes a Constitution save. On failure it cannot regain HP or finite class resources until the end of its next turn and repeats the save then; failure extends the effect one final round. If you were hidden from it when the strike began, the initial failed save also Silences it until the end of its next turn.

source.originalText: Veinlock Nerve Jab: Strike blocks healing/resource gain (2 turns). Silences if hidden (2 Ki).

cards.name: Twilight Mirage
cards.rangeAndTarget: One unoccupied space within 5 feet of you
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Twilight Mirage. Tags: hero, shadow, illusion, weave. Create one illusory duplicate. The first attack that would hit you before the duration ends instead destroys the duplicate and misses you. Once before the duplicate disappears, after you hit with an unarmed strike it mirrors that strike for force damage equal to half the triggering strike's unmodified rolled damage dice total, rounded down once, minimum 1. The mirror is not another attack and triggers nothing.

source.originalText: Twilight Mirage: Summon a 1-turn clone to mirror strikes and intercept attacks (3 Ki).

cards.name: Nerve Fade Technique
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature damaged by your unarmed strike
cards.frequency: At most once per target per turn
cards.effect: Nerve Fade Technique. Tags: hero, shadow, shadow-rot. After an unarmed strike damages a creature, spend 1 Ki to apply one Shadow Rot stack, maximum 2. At the start of the target's turn each stack deals 1d4 psychic damage. At one stack it has -1 on its first saving throw that turn; at two stacks it has -1 on all saving throws that turn. At the end of each turn it makes a Wisdom save, removing all stacks on success.

source.originalText: Nerve Fade Technique: Stacking Shadow Rot debuff (-saves, psychic DoT) (1 Ki).

cards.name: Deathless Silence
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to three enemies you can perceive within 60 feet
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn; max-HP reduction until rest
cards.effect: Final — Deathless Silence. Tags: hero, shadow, final, teleportation, max-hp, weave. Until the start of your next regular turn you cannot be targeted by opportunity attacks or Reactions. Teleport adjacent to up to three different chosen enemies in sequence and make one unarmed strike against each. On each hit, the target makes a Constitution save. Failure reduces its maximum HP by 4 S+M under the common non-stacking rule and suppresses one non-core defensive passive it possesses until the end of its next turn; the Director identifies an applicable visible passive before the save. This does not disable core class engines, legendary rules or creature type traits.

source.originalText: Final – Deathless Silence: Untargetable 1 turn → teleport to 3 enemies and apply Void Palm (max HP -25%, passive disable).

cards.name: Shadow Step
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Shadow Step. Tags: hero, shadow, teleportation, weave. Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you perceive. You become Invisible until you make an attack, deal damage, force a saving throw, start another technique or the duration ends. This movement provokes no opportunity attacks. As a minor Weave technique, the common extra-Ki payment may prevent its 1 Dissonance.

source.originalText: Shadow Step: Briefly step into the shadow realm, becoming untargetable and reappearing at a different location.

cards.name: Nerve Strike
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: Nerve Strike. Tags: hero, shadow, attack, control. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit the target makes a Constitution save. On failure choose one: its Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn, or it loses its Reaction and cannot take Bonus Actions during that period. This causes no permanent nerve injury.

source.originalText: Nerve Strike: Target critical pressure points to temporarily disable an opponent's abilities or movement.

cards.name: Poison Hand
cards.rangeAndTarget: Your next unarmed strike this turn
cards.effect: Poison Hand. Tags: hero, shadow, poison, attack. The next unarmed strike you hit with before the end of this turn deals S d4 additional poison damage. The target then makes a Constitution save; on failure it takes 1d4 poison damage at the start of each of its next 2 turns. Reapplication refreshes rather than stacks the damage-over-time effect.

source.originalText: Poison Hand: Infuse your strikes with toxic ki that causes continuing damage over time.

cards.name: Mind Cloud
cards.effect: Mind Cloud. Tags: hero, shadow, psychic, control, weave. The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it loses its Reaction and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. It repeats the save at the end of that turn; on failure the effect lasts one additional round, then ends automatically. The effect never forces the target to attack allies or surrender control of its full turn.

source.originalText: Mind Cloud: Disrupt an enemy's mental clarity, causing confusion or hallucinations.

cards.name: Death Touch
cards.effect: Death Touch. Tags: hero, shadow, attack, finisher. Make one unarmed strike. On a hit add 3 S d8 necrotic damage. If the target began the strike at or below one-quarter maximum HP, it also makes a Constitution save; on failure add another 2 S d8 necrotic damage. This never causes automatic death, bypasses no ordinary dying rules and creates no permanent injury beyond the damage actually dealt.

source.originalText: Death Touch: Legendary technique that can potentially kill a weakened target instantly by stopping their heart.
